root_cause: Growth Swarm selected accounts, triggers, channels and actions, but message framing, give/get exchange and persuasion learning were not yet a canonical measurable layer.
decision: Insert one persuasion optimizer between prepared action and provider execution. Reuse existing sales actions/outcomes and never increase contact volume merely because persuasion exists.
prevention: Never fabricate social proof, scarcity, urgency, benchmark or financial impact.
Never optimize on activity volume when terminal sales outcomes exist.
Never create a parallel outreach sequence system.
Persuasion may change framing and offered value, not bypass suppression, identity, dedupe, fatigue, opt-out or provider capability.
